<h4><em>Williamstown, Massachusetts</em></h4>
<h2>Correspondent, ABC News</h2>
<p>Will Reeve is widely recognized as a television correspondent at ABC News, most frequently appearing on the network’s flagship programs Good Morning America and World News Tonight with David Muir. Will had many life-shaping experiences at Boys & Girls Clubs — from learning to swim to his parents cheering him on at sporting events to writing and staging his own play in his teens. Prior to his work at ABC News, Will was a correspondent and anchor at ESPN and worked at MSG Network in New York City. Will is also the child of famed “Superman” actor and activist Christopher Reeve and his wife, Dana, and is a proud board member of the Christopher and Dana Reeve Foundation.</p>
<blockquote><p>“My parents thought the Boys & Girls Club represented the best of humanity. I had peers and mentors who encouraged me to become the best version of myself. That’s what any kid deserves, and that’s what every kid gets at the Club.”</p></blockquote>
